svg.aria-label: Thirteen assumptions are leaps of faith
svg.text: Thirteen assumptions are leaps of faith
Rows: how much of the strategy depends on it. Columns: how much evidence exists.

g.text: Leaps of faith: test first
A1 Wants to hold their own keys
A2 Thinks of crypto as a portfolio share
A4 Prefers own rules to a managed service
A8 Can write a policy they understand
A9 Recovery drill builds confidence
A3 Onchain earning beats an ETF for them
A10 Seeing the source changes their choice
A11 Account wording can be made honest
A13 Will pay for it
A14 Segment is large enough
A15 We can reach them
A18 Risk data can be kept current
A21 Risk ratings read as information
Confirm, then rely on it
A20 Own policy keeps us non-discretionary
A23 No competitor ships this yet
A6 Fear of losing access is the main barrier
A17 Policy can be enforced onchain
Test later
A12 Will share wider holdings
A5 Brokerage-style records matter
A7 Exchange holders will move over
A16 Revenue without pushing risk
A22 Enabling rules stay in force (monitor only)
Leave for now
A19 A recovery partner model exists
